quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson predicts Dallas Mavericks would win a championship with Luka Doncic

quotes.quote: If Luka is with this Knicks team, do they win a championship? Yes.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson notes Jalen Brunson has become a more willing passer
quotes.excerpt: I do think that Jalen, what he did change about his game, was he's more willing passer now.
quotes.quote: I do think that Jalen, what he did change about his game, was he's more willing passer now. He's not like the year prior, he was trying to take it all in his own hands. Now, those kickouts to OG, those kickouts to Josh Hart, I think those are happening now. He's become a more complete basketball player.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton bets on Jalen Brunson over Luka Doncic

quotes.quote: I can guarantee you, because you set a stat, I'm going to take a Hail Mary on this one. You said because Luka had a Kyrie, another Alpha, I can guarantee you Luka took more shots than Jalen. I can guarantee it.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson explains why he puts an asterisk on Kevin Durant's championship
quotes.excerpt: I always said Kevin Durant's championship has an asterisk because it's a team that he lost to.
quotes.quote: I always said Kevin Durant's championship has an asterisk because it's a team that he lost to in the finals that won 70-something games, and then you join that team as being one of the best players ever, as being one of the best players.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
